Title: Azure Machine Learning - June 2023 PuPr Announcement - View status of jobs in Azure Pipelines

Body.Content: View statuses of AzureML jobs directly in Azure Pipelines: You can now receive notifications within Azure Pipelines that the Azure Machine Learning job has been completed, and you can then further define automations based on this update.
